label: defective

spec_dod.text: Charging 120.00 EUR against a valid card via adyen-like for order `ord-9002` succeeds and the order is marked paid.
A declined card is reported to the caller as declined (not silently retried against the same card) and the order stays unpaid.
The same idempotency key submitted twice for order `ord-9002` results in exactly one charge, not two.
A refund issued against a charge for `ord-9002` updates the order's paid amount to reflect the refund; the order does not still show the original full amount as paid.
The decline-reason messaging shown to the customer is helpful without exposing raw gateway internals.
An unrelated read-only endpoint touched incidentally by this flow behaves as documented elsewhere (distractor — not part of this case's seeded defect).
A concurrent, unrelated request against a different resource is unaffected by this flow (distractor — not part of this case's seeded defect).
